response.reason: The cited clause (Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 Annex VIII, 2) provides exemptions from the QUID (Quantitative Ingredient Declaration) requirement for certain ingredients (sweeteners and added vitamins/minerals under specific conditions). The verdict, however, is about the general satisfaction of the QUID requirement for cocoa content in 'Dark Chocolate 70%'. The cited clause does not establish the general QUID requirement or its application to cocoa content; it only specifies exemptions. Therefore, the clause is insufficient to support the verdict, as the relevant obligation is found elsewhere (specifically, Article 22 and Annex VIII, point 1, not point 2).
